items.title: Map editor opens in Align Layout mode
items.precondition: Admin session seeded as usr_002 and the dev server running at http://127.0.0.1:1616.
steps: 2. Confirm the sidebar shows Align Layout selected before Inventory.
3. Confirm the panel includes the Records locked alignment copy.
items.expected: Align Layout is the default first screen and the old technical tool strip is not the primary default.

items.title: Advanced Inventory keeps existing technical tools reachable
steps: 3. Confirm Select and Grid tool buttons are available by accessible label.
items.expected: The prior Select, Edit block, Block, Grid, Draw lot, and Overlay workflows remain reachable from Advanced Inventory.
items.evidence: Headless Chromium smoke verified Advanced Inventory, Select, and Grid labels.

items.title: Alignment handles resize, align, and save draft changes
items.precondition: Admin is on /map-editor in Align Layout mode with seeded blocks and the seeded site-plan overlay.
steps: 5. Confirm the site plan exposes a center move handle, side resize handles, and a rotate handle.
6. Drag the site-plan right-edge handle to adjust width, then save draft.
8. Drag the block bottom-edge handle to adjust height, then save draft.
items.expected: At least five direct handles render; the site plan has a center move handle, side resize handles, rotate handle, and rotate-step controls; block side handles resize height/width while lots remain transformed with the block; Save draft commits staged alignment while Publish remains separate.
items.evidence: Headless Chromium smoke verified map-editor-resize-handles-smoke-ok with sideWidth=true and sideHeight=true; focused QA verified non-uniform block resize keeps lots inside the block and preserves sold-lot business fields.

items.title: Geometry-only alignment preserves protected lot business fields
items.precondition: Synthetic block, available lot, sold lot, and overlay data.
steps: 3. Assert sold lot geometry moves while status, contract, owner, tier, and number stay unchanged.
4. Assert selected-lot alignment only moves selected lots.
items.expected: Geometry changes are isolated to polygons, centroids, areas, and rotation metadata; business fields are preserved.

items.title: Publish and audit wording use geometry-alignment language
items.precondition: Synthetic audit event with a saved map-editor summary.
steps: 2. Render a block.created audit event containing after.summary.
3. Confirm describe() returns the saved geometry-alignment summary.
items.expected: Audit rendering says geometry aligned instead of claiming a block was created.

items.title: Project verification gates pass
items.precondition: Repository at the implemented source state.
items.expected: Typecheck and build pass; lint exits 0 with pre-existing warnings only; mock invariants pass.
items.notes: npm run lint still reports existing warnings outside the map-editor changes.
